title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridors 1 and 6 Connector Road (Aktobe–Makat) Reconstruction Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will reconstruct a road section of about 299 kilometers (km) between the capitals and administration centers of Aktobe and Atyrau provinces in western Kazakhstan, and introduce key features of a transport information system. It will upgrade part of a strategic transport corridor and improve transport system operation. The project will thus strengthen overall road sector efficiency, boost connectivity, and promote regional trade and inclusive economic growth, particularly in the western part of Kazakhstan.

Loan 3416: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 19 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Two supervision consultant's contracts completed.
Civil works - 7 packages for a total of 318 km completed.
Lots 1-3 - completed; TOC issued on 1 September 2023.
Lots 4 - completed; TOC issued on 14 November 2023
Lot 5 - completed; TOC issued on 13 November 2023
Lot 6 - completed; TOC issued on 26 May 2023
Lot 7: (i) 17 km original scope completed; TOC issued on 19 July 2019 (ii) Additional scope (Dossor Bypass Road) completed; TOC issued on 18 November 2021.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48424/48424-002-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Feb 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48424/48424-002-iee-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48424/48424-002-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jul 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48424/48424-002-sddr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48424/48424-002-smr-en_16.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Seven civil works contracts completed. Contract for the supply and delivery of equipment was awarded to THG Technik Handel Gessellschaft AG on 31 July 2019. Equipment was delivered. Consulting services for ITS contract was awarded in January 2020. However, the contract lapsed without outcome.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/48424-002/main#project-tenders
